mo_ta_cong_viec:
Job Overview
We are seeking a skilled Data & Business Intelligence Professional to join our team. In this role, you will transform data into meaningful insights through compelling data storytelling and intuitive visualizations, with a strong focus on generating actionable insights that directly support business decision-making.
You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand key problems, design analytics solutions, and deliver impactful dashboards that support data-driven decision-making. 
 
Key Responsibilities 
Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, define key metrics, and translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, root causes, and actionable insights that directly influence business decisions.
Design and develop dashboards with clear business narratives, focusing on driving understanding and decision-making (not just reporting).
Communicate insights clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Perform ad-hoc analyses to support business initiatives, performance tracking, and strategic planning.
Work closely with Data Engineers to understand data pipelines, ensure data quality, and propose data structure improvements for analytics use cases.
Contribute to the design of analytical data models / data marts to enable scalable and reliable analytics.
yeu_cau:
Must-Have:    
Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle).
Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Strong data visualization and data storytelling skills, with proven ability to generate actionable insights that support business decision-making.
Ability to connect data insights to business context, quantify impact, and provide clear recommendations for decision-making.
Good foundational understanding of data pipelines and data transformation to effectively collaborate with Data Engineers on data preparation.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Honesty, dignity, and responsibility.
Precision, passion, open-mindedness, and quick self-learning skills in big data, as well as enthusiasm for solving business problems.
For Senior-level candidates, additional expectations include experience in hypothesis-driven analysis, predictive or forecasting models, scenario modelling, leading end-to-end analytics projects, and delivering strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.
 
 
Nice-to-Have:
Background or experience of financial services, securities, or fintech.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP, Azure, AWS).
Experience with Python, R, or similar programming languages.
Exposure to or ongoing learning in Data Science, Data Modelling, or Data Governance concepts.
